 LIVE: Benfica vs. Alverca | Liga Portugal
 Benfica hosts Alverca at Estádio da Luz in Matchday 10 of the 2026-27 Liga Portugal season. The Eagles aim to close the gap at the top of the standings in a match you can watch LIVE on beIN SPORTS.
 Benfica vs. Alverca LIVE on beIN SPORTS 
 The excitement of Liga Portugal continues on beIN SPORTS as Benfica takes on Alverca in Matchday 10 of the 2026-27 season.
 Lisbon's Estádio da Luz will host an important clash for both teams, particularly the Eagles, who need all three points to remain in contention for the league title.
 Don't miss Benfica vs. Alverca LIVE on beIN SPORTS , featuring all the excitement of one of the matches closing out the Portuguese league's latest round of fixtures.
 Benfica enters the match in second place with 22 points , having recorded seven wins, one draw, and one defeat.
 Ahead of them is Porto , which leads the standings with 30 points. A victory would take the Lisbon club to 25 points and reduce the gap to the top spot.
 How Are Benfica and Alverca Heading Into This Match?
 Benfica enters the contest with confidence after securing a 2-1 victory over Santa Clara in its previous match.
 The Eagles have impressed offensively, scoring 26 goals and conceding just eight in their first nine league matches.
 One of their standout players is Vangelis Pavlidis , who has registered nine goals and three assists in nine appearances in the competition.
 Meanwhile, Alverca sits in 10th place with 11 points , following three wins, two draws, and four defeats.
 The visitors will look to bounce back from their 1-0 loss to Arouca and pull off an upset against one of the leading title contenders.
 Benfica Dominates the Head-to-Head Record Against Alverca
 The historical record favors Benfica , which has won six consecutive league meetings against Alverca .
 Across 12 previous top-flight encounters, the Eagles have recorded eight victories, one draw, and three defeats.
 During the 2025-26 season, Benfica won both meetings by a 2-1 scoreline , securing victories both home and away.
 Now, the Lisbon side will attempt to extend its dominance against an opponent looking to collect valuable points and climb the standings.
 Where to Watch Benfica vs. Alverca LIVE
 The match between Benfica and Alverca takes place on Monday, November 2, at Estádio da Luz, as part of Matchday 10 of Liga Portugal .
 You can watch Benfica vs. Alverca LIVE on beIN SPORTS , bringing you all the intensity of Portuguese soccer in a matchup that could have significant implications for the league standings.
 The Eagles are looking to close the gap at the top, while Alverca hopes to spring a surprise in Lisbon.
